* '''Original''' ([[Yavin 4 (V)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). * '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-yavin4.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/yavin4.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark.
